1936, July
FATHER SOLANUS, NOTEBOOK NO. 6.
Page 129 July 22 Mrs. Honore Miercier - 39 - of Quebec - five sons and fears cancer of stomach.
22 Joan Geary - 17 - adhesings
Mrs. Evelyn Coppe - 49 - from Mont Royal - tuomer on brain, can hardly ever sleep, now almost blind. She still hopes to be cured and hoping thus is able to smile ... Deo Gr. Two yrs. ago was given 60 days to live.
24 Mary Arns - 58 - Vericose veins
Rose Curtin - 46 - also vericose veins has 7 children to support ... Emma Casey ....
27 Fr. Coughlin .... n. Cath's for
Mrs. Bertha Ferrell - 58 - n. Cath, two strokes and cancer on leg. Dr's wanted to take leg off. now O.K.
Jane Mergaert - 16 - enimic-very poor sight.
Page 130 July 28 John Preczewck - 66 - not to confession for many years; talks and acts very unbecoming - Enrolled To-day - wife promising perpetual ....
Mrs. Nell Butler - 41 - lost breast 3 months ago. Now having very serious trouble with stomach - has husband & 8 small children in hopes of her recovery ... now 4 days unconscious.
Mrs. Orlando - 39 - losing property - 4 children, husband gets only 162 per week. Has five rooms & bath upstairs to rent - 9868 Not- tingham Rd.
28 Jos. Beima - 48 - Enrolled last Friday that he might go to sacra- ments before dying of cancer - had been away from confession about 20 yrs. and for him religion seemed a joke. Had forgotten how to pray - was seemingly dead to grace .. To-night made his con- fession and already improving. 29 To-day received Holy Communion. Asks prayers of thanksgiving; hopes to go back to work Monday. Nov. 20th (Bottom of next page-131) reported as back to work now two weeks - has gained 14 1bs. Tongue completly healed. Deo Gratias. ( See Dec. 27-'8 )
